messages:
erin: follow-up from the pm: we keep getting duplicate paging for 'upstream timeouts' during nightly batch windows. need a short, actionable plan to reduce noise while preserving escalation for real regressions.

sam: saw ~47 pages last night, mostly identical stack traces across instances. oncall got paged at 02:12 for the same root cause 6x. painful.

taylor: propose: 1) add a batch-window suppression for known nightly jobs (02:00-03:30 UTC) that converts p2->digest, 2) dedupe key = job_name + upstream_host + error_code, 3) keep a global metric override: if upstream_error_rate > 1000/min then bypass suppression.

michael: +1. also add last-success and replica-lag annotations so dedupe doesn't hide slow-degrading situations. recommended dedupe window 20m for non-prod, 8m for prod.

devops-bot: runbook updated by @erin: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/upstream-timeout

sam: small rule sketch I tested in staging: ```yaml
alert: UpstreamTimeouts
expr: sum(rate(upstream_timeouts[1m])) by (job_name, upstream_host)
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: p2
annotations:
  summary: "Upstream timeouts ({{job_name}} -> {{upstream_host}})"
```
apply suppression: if time in window && severity==p2 -> notify=digest

taylor: timeline suggestion: PR by Thu EOD, staging deploy Fri AM, 48h observation, prod Mon if green. Owners: sam (rule PR), erin (runbook + digest), michael (monitoring + rollback plan).

erin: i'll add a small Grafana tile that shows pre/post alert counts + dedupe closed count. want to validate reduction quickly.

michael: i'll wire the digest to #batch-owners and include top 5 fingerprints and last-success times.

sam: one more: auto-close suppressed duplicates after 25m so alert backlog doesn't snowball. but auto-reopen if error rate increases >2x within 10m.

taylor: agree. i'll add tests to replay a night of alerts against the dedupe logic to measure expected reduction.

erin: action recap: sam -> PR; erin -> runbook + dashboard; michael -> digest hook + monitoring; taylor -> dedupe tests. target: PR merged Thu EOD. reconvene Mon 11am post-prod to verify. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: @channel on-call this weekend: Fri -> @sam, Sat -> @taylor, Sun -> @erin.
